labels.cancelled_note: The run was cancelled by the user; only the items processed before cancellation are reported.
labels.method_text: RV Hub read the case folder without changing it: the hash chains of the case log and of every run's audit and review logs were recomputed, each run's links with the case log and its timestamp tokens were checked, and (with --rehash) every registered evidence file was hashed again and compared with the registry. Where the run's own tool was installed and Rakvor-signed, its verify-log was asked for the same verdict. Every action was written to a hash-chained audit log.
labels.next_ok: No action needed for this item.
labels.next_attention: Review the findings below with your examiner.
labels.next_problem: Do not rely on this part of the case until the examiner has explained the problem.
labels.summary_ok: This item was verified. The checks applied found no sign of alteration.
labels.summary_attention: This item was verified. Some points need attention.
labels.summary_problem: This item fails verification: it was altered, is missing, or could not be verified.
labels.fingerprint_text: This fingerprint identifies the exact content of the file that was verified. Any change, even of one character, would produce a different value.
labels.timestamp_pending: Pending — the time-stamping service could not be reached; add it later with the timestamp command
labels.not_signed: This PDF is not digitally signed.

EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.title: Differs from the evidence registered in the case
EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.shows: The %{algorithm} of this file is %{actual}, but evidence %{evidence_id} was registered at intake with %{expected}: the file examined is not bit-identical to the registered item.
EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.does_not_prove: Who changed the file, when, or whether the change was deliberate; the analysis still ran so the examiner can decide.

EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.title: Not registered in the case
EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.shows: No item of case %{case_id} was registered with this path or this content, so its continuity from intake cannot be shown.
EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.does_not_prove: That the file is altered or irrelevant; it may simply not have gone through intake.

CASE_LOG_BROKEN.title: Case log broken
CASE_LOG_BROKEN.shows: The case log (case-log.jsonl), case.json or the registry digest fails verification: %{problem}.
CASE_LOG_BROKEN.does_not_prove: Who changed the file or when; the runs' own logs are checked separately and may still be intact.

RUN_LOG_BROKEN.title: Run log broken
RUN_LOG_BROKEN.shows: The audit log of run %{run} fails verification: %{problem}.
RUN_LOG_BROKEN.does_not_prove: What the edit changed or who made it; the run's reports cannot be relied on until it is explained.

REVIEW_LOG_BROKEN.title: Review log broken
REVIEW_LOG_BROKEN.shows: The review log (review.jsonl) of run %{run} fails verification: %{problem}.
REVIEW_LOG_BROKEN.does_not_prove: That the run's own audit log or reports were changed; only the record of what was viewed after the run is in doubt.

RUN_NOT_IN_CASE_LOG.title: Run not recorded in the case log
RUN_NOT_IN_CASE_LOG.shows: The folder %{run} holds a run that the case log never announced (no run_started entry for it).
RUN_NOT_IN_CASE_LOG.does_not_prove: That the run's content is false; it may have been copied in from another case or its case-log entries removed.

TOOL_VERIFY_DISAGREES.title: The tool's own verification disagrees
TOOL_VERIFY_DISAGREES.shows: RV Hub found the logs of run %{run} %{hub}, but %{tool} verify-log answered %{tool_verdict} (exit code %{exit_code}).
TOOL_VERIFY_DISAGREES.does_not_prove: Which of the two is right; a disagreement means the two verifier implementations differ and must be examined before the case is relied on.

EVIDENCE_REHASH_MISMATCH.title: Evidence differs from the registry
EVIDENCE_REHASH_MISMATCH.shows: Evidence %{evidence_id} (%{path}) now has %{algorithm} %{actual}, but was registered with %{expected}: the file is not bit-identical to the registered item.
EVIDENCE_REHASH_MISMATCH.does_not_prove: Who changed the file or when; a different copy may have been found under the same name.

EVIDENCE_MISSING.title: Registered evidence not found
EVIDENCE_MISSING.shows: Evidence %{evidence_id} (registered at %{path}) could not be re-hashed: %{reason}.
EVIDENCE_MISSING.does_not_prove: That the evidence was lost or destroyed; it may be stored elsewhere (give its folder with --evidence-dir).

UNKNOWN_LOG_FORMAT.title: Unknown log format
UNKNOWN_LOG_FORMAT.shows: Run %{run} holds %{file}, a log RV Hub does not know how to verify.
UNKNOWN_LOG_FORMAT.does_not_prove: That the file was tampered with or is harmless; it is simply not checked.

TIMESTAMP_PENDING.title: Trusted timestamp pending
TIMESTAMP_PENDING.shows: Run %{run} has no RFC 3161 timestamp yet: the authority could not be reached when the run finished.
TIMESTAMP_PENDING.does_not_prove: That the log is wrong; until a timestamp is added with `timestamp`, nothing outside the case proves when the log existed.

CROSSCHECK_UNAVAILABLE.title: Cross-check with the tool not done
CROSSCHECK_UNAVAILABLE.shows: The logs of run %{run} were not also verified by %{tool} itself: %{reason}.
CROSSCHECK_UNAVAILABLE.does_not_prove: Any problem with the run; RV Hub's own verification of the run still applies.

RUN_LOG_INTACT.title: Run log intact
RUN_LOG_INTACT.shows: The audit log of run %{run} (%{entries} entries) is an unbroken chain, linked to the case log as recorded.
RUN_LOG_INTACT.does_not_prove: That the analysis results are correct or the evidence authentic; only that the record of the run was not altered since it was written.

TOOL_SIGNED_RAKVOR.title: Signed by Rakvor
TOOL_SIGNED_RAKVOR.shows: %{exe} carries a valid code signature that chains to the Rakvor root certificate.
TOOL_SIGNED_RAKVOR.does_not_prove: That the program is free of defects; only that it is the build Rakvor signed, unchanged.

TOOL_SIGNED_OTHER_ROOT.title: Signed under another root
TOOL_SIGNED_OTHER_ROOT.shows: %{exe} is signed, but its certificate chain ends at another root (SHA-256 %{root_sha256}), not the Rakvor root.
TOOL_SIGNED_OTHER_ROOT.does_not_prove: That the program is malicious; it is not the Rakvor build and its results must not be presented as Rakvor's.

TOOL_SIGNATURE_INVALID.title: Signature invalid
TOOL_SIGNATURE_INVALID.shows: The code signature of %{exe} does not verify: %{reason}.
TOOL_SIGNATURE_INVALID.does_not_prove: Who changed the program or why; do not use it for evidence until it is reinstalled from a verified release.

TOOL_UNSIGNED.title: Not signed
TOOL_UNSIGNED.shows: %{exe} carries no code signature (for example a development build).
TOOL_UNSIGNED.does_not_prove: That the program is faulty or malicious; only that nothing shows it is the Rakvor release.

limitations.VERIFICATION_PROVES_INTEGRITY_NOT_CONTEN: Verification shows that the case log, the run logs and (with --rehash) the evidence files have not changed since they were recorded; it does not show that the tools' findings are correct or that the evidence is authentic.
limitations.SIGNATURE_CHECK_WINDOWS_ONLY: The code signatures of the tools are checked on Windows only (Authenticode); elsewhere they are reported as not checked.
limitations.CROSSCHECK_NEEDS_INSTALLED_TOOLS: A run's logs are also verified by the run's own tool only when that tool is installed on this workstation and signed by Rakvor; otherwise only RV Hub's verification applies.
limitations.TIMESTAMP_PROVES_EXISTENCE_ONLY: A trusted timestamp proves the audit log existed in this exact form at the stated time; it does not prove that the examined copy matches the original source.

ui.evidence_help: Choose the case folder to verify (the folder that holds case.json). You can also drag it onto this window. Nothing in it is changed: RV Hub only adds its own run.
ui.hash_tip_two: Two algorithms are already selected: untick one first.
ui.hash_tip_one: At least one algorithm is required.
ui.cancelling: Cancelling: finishing the current file, then writing partial reports…
ui.out_from_case: The verification run is written into the case folder
ui.rehash: Also re-hash the registered evidence files
ui.evidence_dir_hint: optional: folder where the evidence is now
ui.crosscheck: Ask each run's own tool to verify its logs too (installed, Rakvor-signed tools)
ui.out_dir_broken: Output folder if the case log is broken
